notes.title: Fix & Hat!
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where playable dog couldn't dig anymore if you switched back during the dig animation.
- Added another hat somewhere in the map.
- Another item that isn't a hat can be a hat ;)

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: A little fix for possible performance issue when playing as dog.

notes.title: Characters, Hats, Achievements & Dog Mode!
notes.content:
[h1]You can now change human and dog skins[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054963/975cb370abb9d8a64ee9d101bbd1d09bd58cd1fb.png[/img]

The skins can be changed when you start or load a game. But you can also change them from the options menu while playing, so you aren't stuck with your initial selection.

[h2]Equipable hats[/h2]

Some hats got lost in the map, find them and wear them! But they currently only fit on the human head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054963/e9300b7d375ebbddfa358509d949ebec205f4741.png[/img]

[h2]Play as the dog[/h2]

If you finished the game once, you can now play as the dog!
You can still do all the same things, run, explore, watch photos, do puzzles, get achievements and even play fetch with your human. You can also find a new minigame and become superdog!
When you throw dog toys at the human, they will be thrown back, but other items will get stored in the backpack.

[h2]New achievements[/h2]
There are new achievements that might be a bit harder to do, but I'm sure you can figure them out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054963/19a1fbfb7084b95eb839cce41289729f7cddecb3.png[/img]

notes.title: A couple of minor fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Recycle achievement is no longer granted without actually bringing back a plastic bottle
[*]Fixed an issue where dog could dig up stuff while being far away
[*]Added some extra text lines when you "play" with the ants
[*]Added a little hint to the apple tree that will sometimes pop up
[/list]

notes.title: A Little Winter Update
notes.content:
It got cold and it started snowing under the mountain! 
You might also get a new achievement if you "fight" the snowman.

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*] Snow area, with a new achievement, photo, snowballs and falling snow
[*] Option to enable snow mode for the whole game (after finishing the game once)
[*] Fixed dog getting stuck if he can't poop
[*] Dog will poop more if he eats things
[*] Added a close button to the snake minigame
[*] Some gamepad mouse pointer tweaks
[*] Some typo fixes and text tweaks
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054963/facdeecf28cca6c78a4c49bfe99c6c2c9120dafc.png[/img]

notes.title: Fixed car door & gnome achievement
notes.content:
I made a couple of fixes to the game:
[list]
[*] Gnome Home is no longer a free achievement, you have to actually bring the gnome with you.
[*] A naughty butterfly was remotely moving the car door, which could make entering the car difficult. Car door should now stay put and the trigger is a bit bigger.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43054963/ea54c36d77d00ce2012ca5b50fa15f9a381dbc7c.png[/img]
